A '''greatcoat''' was an a long overcoat worn by [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] beings.

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the notorious [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] often wore a greatcoat made of [[nashtah]] leather. After the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] discarded his [[Jedi apparel/Legends|Jedi robes]] for an ankle-length greatcoat, which he wore over a vest and pants. Over a century later, [[Cade Skywalker]] also wore a greatcoat when he lived as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], bounty hunter and [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]]. Other types of greatcoats included the [[Preter Jacket]].
